quest.title: Stories to Sate the Glass and Scroll
quest.description: Witch's Homework was born from discussions between Varka and the witches. The task assigned to Varka himself appears to be...
quest.rewards_formatted: Hero's Wit x3, Guide to Freedom x3, Mora x30000, Varka's Invitation Ticket x1

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know, since it was Varka who came up with the whole idea of holding a "conference" with the Hexenzirkel, how come we never found out what task they gave him?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's see... Varka, Varka... Wait, why's it blank?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't we just go ask him ourselves?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good point... Well, knowing what he's like, we'd better start by checking all the local taverns and restaurants...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: ...Still not here, huh? Looks like I'll have to figure this out on my own.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Speak of the devil, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Varka! We wanted to ask you about your "task"...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Oh, hey there, Honorary Knight and Paimon! My "task"...? What's all this about?

choices.text: The Hexenzirkel have set tasks for everyone...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Now that you mention it, I'm pretty sure Alice did tell me something about that... I think?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You "think"? That "conference" of yours is why those "tasks" even exist in the first place! ...Ugh, anyway, why *is* yours blank?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...If I had to take a wild guess, probably 'cause it'd be too much for that little book of theirs to handle.

choices.text: Now I'm listening.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: My task... is to make the finest wine Teyvat has ever seen.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...How's that "too much"!?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Trust me, this is serious business... See this new scar on my arm? That's what it cost me just to get my hands on the recipe.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: There I was, venturing into a deep, dark Domain, battling some of the fiercest, most vicious monsters I've ever seen...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Seriously...?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Now we're just three special ingredients short of finishing this thing! Honorary Knight, Paimon, would you be willing to lend me a hand?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, fine, why not... Since it's only three things, Paimon's just gonna pretend she buys your story.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Alright! Hehe... So, we still need "wood chips struck by knights," "pigeon feathers shed in joy," and "medicinal broth brewed in a large cauldron."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a sec... Weren't we supposed to be making "wine"? This sounds like some kind of super suspicious potion!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Hmm, good point... Well, our taskmasters are a bunch of mages, after all!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: We're following the recipe to the letter, so all three ingredients must adhere to their requirements. C'mon, let's get started with those wood chips!

choices.text: How "much" are we talking?
But yours seems to be blank.

talks.objective: Go to the Knights of Favonius training ground

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this is where we'll be getting those "wood chips struck by knights," huh...

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Ah! Grand Master! Honorary Knight! Are you here to train as well?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Well, maybe not in a traditional sense... But we're here to pursue a goal, so I guess that counts too!

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: You're already so skilled, yet you still strive for perfection... Please, train however you like! I'll be taking notes from the side!

talks.objective: Go to the Knights of Favonius training ground
Destroy all the training dummies within the time limit
Destroy all the training dummies within the time limit

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: The training ground's all yours. Oh, to witness a pair of top masters in action... What luck!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: The old boozebrain will be okay, though, won't he?

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Amazing! So THAT's how you do it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... Why does Paimon feel like she's heard that reaction like a hundred times before...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Hmm... Yep, this'll do! The shape, the texture, the quality... brilliant.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How you can tell one wood chip apart from another is beyond Paimon... Whatever, as long as you're happy. Next up, those "pigeon feathers shed in joy"...

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Hey! You've scared off all the pigeons...

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: ...G—Grand Master?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Hey, if it isn't little Timmie! Grown up quite a bit, haven't you? Been eating well?

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Y—Yes Sir! I always remember what you told me — that I've gotta eat well and exercise hard if I wanna grow up big and strong!

choices.text: This kid's attitude...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, guess that's the Varka effect... Honestly, Paimon would be shocked if there was a single kid in this city who didn't look up to our "living legend" over here!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Sorry for scaring your pigeons away.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: I was actually gonna ask... Is there a way to approach pigeons without spooking them... while keeping them happy at the same time?

response.speaker: Timmie
response.text: Hmm... To be honest, I usually just walk up to them quietly and scatter some feed...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Boom, that's it! Say, you got any extra feed on you right now?

response.speaker: Timmie
response.text: I do have quite a bit, but... Grand Master... Um... What are you planning to do...?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Don't worry, little man, we just need to borrow a feather or two... You have my word!

response.speaker: Timmie
response.text: Ah... Alright then, no problem! And thank you, Grand Master!

choices.text: It changed in a heartbeat!

talks.objective: Go to where the pigeons gather

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Looks like we've got ourselves some pigeon tracks. Let's wait here.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: When they appear, walk up to them quietly and scatter the feed... but make sure not to hurt them. Ready?

talks.objective: Go to where the pigeons gather

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Looks like we've got ourselves some pigeon tracks. Let's wait here.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: When they appear, walk up to them quietly and scatter the feed... but make sure not to hurt them. Ready?

dialogues.speaker: Pigeon
dialogues.text: Coo...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Got 'em! The feathers are in the bag — I repeat, the feathers are in the bag.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Finally! This task really is harder than Paimon thought...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Just one more ingredient to go... "Medicinal broth brewed in a large cauldron." That's gotta be Dadaupa Gorge.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: I'll head over there right away. Follow whenever you can, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, wait a—! Geez, talk about excited... That guy just took off faster than a flock of flustered pigeons...

choices.text: Classic "free as the wind" mentality...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: ...That old boozehound!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Hmm? Who's there?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Ah!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Diona? What are you doing here? And why were you hiding...?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: I... I'm only here to pick some fruit, I swear! Just didn't expect I'd run into that piece of work all the way out here...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Ugh, he's been bugging me non-stop lately, trying to talk me into making him some drink again. I got so sick of it that I've been avoiding him whenever I can...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What's the story behind this drink, then?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: So, you know how he returned recently with some of the expeditionary force, right? Well, guess what? Practically the first thing he did was swing by The Cat's Tail for a celebratory "drink or two"...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seriously? Paimon thought they'd have just stayed back at the Knights of Favonius headquarters...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Always had Varka down as more of an Angel's Share kinda guy myself...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Ugh... Hence why I said "practically." They did all that, and more! The Cat's Tail was round three of a citywide tavern crawl...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...And Paimon bets they'll do it all over again the next time another batch of troops returns home.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No doubt about that.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Anyhoo, long story short, I couldn't bear the sight of those drunk old skunks for even one second longer! So I made it my mission to mix 'em the most disgusting, nauseating drinks in all of Teyvat...

choices.text: But, Diona...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Yeah... So that's why I tried to get Prince to mix the drinks instead. Ugh, if only those drunkards hadn't started messin' with his meowjo...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: ...In the end, Prince ran off before he could finish. 'Least he gave that old boozer a nice big scratch on the way out! Hahahaha!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Ahh, so that's how Varka got his scar...)

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: There I was, venturing into a deep, dark Dom{RUBY#[D]tavern}ain, battling some of the fiercest, most vicious mons{RUBY#[D]Prince}ters I've ever seen...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Anyway, it was right there in front of me, one small step away from completion...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...So you applied the finishing touches yourself?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Yeah.

choices.text: Just out of curiosity, let me ask one more thing...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Um... Some wood chips I noticed on the knights' clothes, some pigeon feathers I picked up in the forest...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: ...And some of the hilichurl herbal soup I was planning to turn into a remedy for sobering up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a sec... You said this all happened not long after Varka first got back, right? That must mean...

choices.text: No one's told him...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-oh, this could be bad! We've gotta go stop him before it's too late!

choices.text: ...That only Diona herself could make such an awful recipe taste good!
What did you put in there?
You couldn't make a bad drink even if you tried.
Bet he can barely wait for the drinks to start flowing.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Unbelievable... Since when were hilichurls so amenable to reason?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ella! You haven't seen Varka around here, have you!?

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: As a matter of fact, yes I have. Just now, he went off to borrow a "large cauldron" from the hilichurls... and get this — they gave it up as soon as they saw him!

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: The weirdest thing was, they barely exchanged any words at all. I just don't understand how it all went so smoothly... Could the Grand Master know some hilichurl body language that I'm unaware of?

choices.text: I don't think that was "communication"...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, that's not the point here! Anyway, where is he now?

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: Right over there.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Finally, it's done! The finest wine in all of Teyvat... Right here, in my hands!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Varka! Don't—

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Oh, hey gang — you finally made it! Those hilichurls just now were surprisingly reasonable... Didn't expect this to go half so smoothly, hah.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Anyway, time to find out what this bad boy tastes like!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Wait, don't drink it!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Huh? You wanna taste it first? Hehe, dream on, kid... The honor of the first cup's mine!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's not what I'm—

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Don't worry! I'll leave some for ya!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: *chug* *chug* Ahhh... Hrrgh?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Hold up... Why do I feel... so bad...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Varka! Are you okay? Varka? Varkaaa!

choices.text: Grand Master!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on! You didn't defeat a god just to bite the dust here!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Ugh... Agh...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...For a moment there, I could've sworn I saw all the previous Knights of Boreas standing right here in front of me...

choices.text: I don't know if I should chew you out for ending up like this...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Either way, I need a moment to digest it all... both the drink, and the lesson too.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You give Varka the rundown on Diona's infallible knack for mixing drinks.\n"In other words," you tell him, "only she could turn such strange ingredients into top-rate liquor..."

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Aha, so the missing ingredient was actually the spring fairy's blessing... Haha, never would've guessed!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, don't you act all innocent! You still owe us one for trying to pull the wool over our eyes!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Sorry, sorry... Truth is, though, I genuinely believed it would work — and I was even planning to come clean over a drink or two afterwards, anyway...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: But I guess... you probably don't wanna drink it anymore, do you?

choices.text: I think... I'll pass.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Hmm... Well, guess I owe you one! How about this — I'll treat you to a meal at the Good Hunter once we're back.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now that's more like it!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're way too easy to bribe...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, c'mon! You saw what a state he was in after he downed that cup. Paimon's sure he's learned his lesson!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: *sigh* Guess I have no one to blame but myself, huh...

choices.text: Aaaanyway... Back to the subject of your "task."

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Haha, well... I was gonna save that story for the tavern, but I guess the open air will have to do.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...So you're giving "tasks" to everyone in Mondstadt, huh? Interesting idea... Do I get one, too?

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Hah! Well, if you really must know, yours was to "change the fate reflected in the scryglass." But you already did that quite some time ago — the moment you decided to set off on your expedition, to be precise.

choices.text: Why is it blank?
Not sure if I've got that kinda courage.
Or marvel that you're still standing at all...?
C'mon dude, get a hold of yourself!
At least, not in any recognizable language — body or otherwise...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Give me a moment...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Ellin brings out new wooden dummies...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon had no idea the Knights of Favonius had training dummies this huge!

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: My father made this as a special collector's edition! I'm sure it'll prove worthy of your skills!

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Haha, then let's give it a shot!

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Hmm... No, we're not quite getting the quality I saw that day... Let's try again.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Hey, you scared 'em away! Guess we'll have to wait for them to come back now...
